caption: The drawing depicts a single bucket with a cylindrical shape viewed from an elevated angle. The exterior of the bucket is dark in color, predominantly black or very dark blue, with lighter shades and highlights indicating contours and texture. The interior is a contrasting reddish-brown color. The top edge of the bucket is reinforced with a thick, rounded rim, and there are two large metal rings attached at either side near the rim, each secured by smaller gold or brass loops. The word "SMITH" is prominently displayed across the front of the bucket in large, uppercase letters, rendered in a pale yellow or off-white color. The bottom edge features a line of visible stitching in a golden color. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige tone with no additional objects or scenery. In the bottom right corner, the artist's signature, "E. Schwabe," is present.
title: Leather Fire Bucket
